notes:
Notes for "did the leafs win last night" (today is Monday, Oct 12, 2026). I'm assuming the Toronto Maple Leafs, since the question doesn't say which Leafs.

- **No game on Sunday, Oct 11.** The Yahoo Sports schedule lists Toronto's October games as Oct 3, 6, 8 and 10. It shows nothing for Oct 11 or 12. The next game listed is Oct 13 at Utah. The Yahoo page is the only source I found that shows the schedule this way, and the page's age label was unclear.
- **The most recent game was Saturday night, Oct 10, and Toronto won.** William Nylander scored twice and had three assists in the Maple Leafs' 6-3 win against the Colorado Avalanche at Ball Arena on Saturday. The NHL.com recap is dated Oct 11, but it describes the game as Saturday. NHL.com's Leafs video page labels the post-game coverage "October 10, 2026."
- **More from the recap:** Auston Matthews scored twice and had two assists, Nick Blankenburg scored in his Toronto debut, and the Leafs (3-2-1) got their first road win of the season. Sergei Bobrovsky made 30 saves for his first win of the season.
- **Injury news:** headlines on the Yahoo page mention a Chris Tanev injury after an early exit against the Avalanche.
- **Results to ignore:** the Covers.com page shows a different set of scores and dates that don't match the NHL.com and ESPN reports, so I didn't use it.
